About

Ivian Marrie

Ivian Marrie started her design career in Brazil, graduating in Architecture and Urban Planning in 2013, followed by a Master's degree in Architecture and Lighting. After moving to the U.S. in 2021, she worked with some of the most prestigious interior design studios and most exclusive clients.

With experience across North and South America, she has been part of more than 120 projects, including luxury residential developments, high-end penthouses, private residences and custom super yachts.

Her design style combines elegance, functionality and attention to detail, creating spaces that feel refined, personal and timeless. From initial concept through completion, the projects reflect each client's personality, where beauty, comfort and well-being come together.
